title: 复古钦奈旅行海报
author: Dhilip Subramanian
categories: 海报 / 传单,复古 / 怀旧,插画,建筑 / 室内,风景 / 自然
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vintage travel poster for CHENNAI, INDIA, evoking an early 20th-century railway tourism advertisement.

Canvas: Vertical poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, warm aged paper background in ochre, sepia, and sunset orange. Add a thin double-line rectangular border close to the edge, printed in muted reddish brown.

Layout: Huge uppercase title across the top reading CHENNAI in a tall condensed slab-serif style, dark teal ink, occupying about the top quarter of the poster. Beneath it on the left, place the smaller wide-spaced uppercase country label INDIA in burnt red. Below that, include a small line-art temple gopuram icon centered over the tagline Gateway to the South. in italic serif script. Under the tagline add a tiny decorative divider with two short horizontal lines and a centered dot, then the coordinates 13.0827° N, 80.2707° E in small monospaced lettering.

Main scene: The lower two-thirds show a golden sunset beach in Chennai with the sea on the left, glowing sun low near the horizon, gentle waves, wet reflective sand, and a monumental South Indian temple gopuram dominating the right side. Render the temple as an extremely detailed carved Dravidian tower in dark amber and bronze shadows, rising from the shoreline wall; include two additional smaller temple towers receding into the distance near the center-left background. Add palm silhouettes and a low coastal promenade wall.

Foreground details: Include exactly 3 prominent fishing boats: one large wooden boat stretching across the bottom foreground, one narrow boat pulled onto the beach near the center-right, and one more boat farther right near the waterline. Include exactly 6 visible human figures: two silhouetted fishermen in the left and center foreground beside the large boat, one standing fisherman on the right foreground, and three smaller figures near the boats in the midground. Add exactly 5 small birds in the sky over the sea.

Visual style: Lithographic vintage travel-poster illustration, soft grain, subtle paper texture, limited ink palette of teal, burnt sienna, ochre, and deep brown. Strong atmospheric perspective, dramatic warm sunset lighting, crisp poster typography, no modern objects, no photorealistic camera look, no watermark.\

prompt_en: Create a bold cartoon manga-style illustration of Kobe waterfront at Meriken Park under a bright blue sky. In the foreground on a brick-paved harbor promenade, show a dramatic confrontation between exactly 2 main subjects: a fierce blonde anime girl and a huge wild boar. The girl stands on the left in a wide fighting stance, wearing a dark red sweater, black pants, and black-and-white sneakers, with long yellow-blonde hair and angry blue eyes; she grips a red Kobe Port Tower like an oversized baseball bat, with the white word “KOBE” visible near the top. The boar stands on the right, enormous and bristly, dark brown with black outlines, red angry eyes, a pink snout, large white tusks, sharp teeth, scratches on its flank, and a lowered charging posture. Along the bottom edge, include exactly 6 frightened bystanders seen from behind or in profile, all reacting with open mouths and shock marks: a spiky-haired man in a green hoodie, a brown-haired woman in a pink top, a man in a blue cap and jacket raising one hand, a woman with a bun in a yellow hoodie, a black-haired man in a gray hoodie, and a partially cropped man in a blue cap on the far right. Behind the promenade, draw dark blue harbor water and a detailed Kobe skyline with exactly 5 recognizable landmarks: a white sail-like maritime museum structure on the left, a red Kobe Port Tower shape behind the girl, a tall rectangular hotel tower near center, a white stepped hotel building on the right, and a red Ferris wheel at far right. Add exactly 5 puffy white clouds outlined in black across the sky. Use thick black comic outlines, flat saturated colors, exaggerated expressions, hand-drawn ink texture, dynamic action composition, and a humorous kaiju-meets-city-tourism feeling. Avoid photorealism, avoid extra text besides “KOBE,” and keep the scene as a single wide 16:9 illustration.\

title: 地球剖面图层信息图
author: G2（じーにー）｜AIビジネス翻訳家
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,摄影,3D 渲染,风景 / 自然,图解 / 图表
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dramatic scientific cutaway infographic of Earth, showing the planet in space with its internal layers exposed like a precise 3D sectional model.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, high-resolution, black star-filled space background. The planet fills most of the left and center of the frame, with annotation text arranged on the right side.

Main subject: A photorealistic Earth viewed from space, centered slightly left, with Asia, Japan, Southeast Asia, and Australia visible on the surface. Remove a large wedge-shaped quarter section from the front-right side of the globe to reveal the interior. The cutaway should look physically carved, with a thick rocky crust rim and glowing internal layers. Add a subtle blue atmospheric glow around the planet.

Cutaway structure: Show exactly 4 discrete internal/structural layers, each visually distinct and aligned with annotation leader lines: 1) a thin brown rocky crust at the outer edge, 2) a thick red-orange molten mantle layer with turbulent texture, 3) a bright orange outer core surrounding the center, and 4) a glowing yellow-white inner core sphere at the center. Make the mantle the largest visible layer, the outer core semi-spherical and luminous, and the inner core intensely bright with swirling heat texture.

Text and labels: Place exactly 4 Japanese annotation blocks on the right, each with a white dot marker and thin white leader line pointing to the correct layer. Use bold white Japanese headings and smaller white explanatory text beneath each heading. The four visible labels must be: 地殻 with smaller text “地球の最も外側の薄い層。”; マントル with smaller text “厚さ約2,900kmの層。高温の岩石がゆっくりと流動している。”; 外核 with smaller text “厚さ約2,200kmの層。主に鉄とニッケルの流体で構成される。”; 内核 with smaller text “半径約1,220kmの固体の層。主に鉄とニッケルでできており、非常に高温・高圧の環境にある。”

Visual style: Photorealistic space-science educational poster, cinematic lighting, crisp typography, realistic Earth texture, glowing lava-like interior, clean white callout lines, high contrast, polished museum infographic style.

Constraints: Keep exactly 4 annotation blocks and exactly 4 layer labels. Do not add extra icons, extra labels, borders, logos, watermarks, or decorative UI panels. Keep all text legible and positioned to the right of the planet.\

title: 动漫 GI 光照比较
author: ふぃあ
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,动漫 / 漫画,插画,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a side-by-side comparison graphic demonstrating global illumination / indirect bounce lighting improvement on the same anime illustration.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal image, split exactly into two equal vertical panels with a thin white divider line down the center. Use a soft pastel anime illustration style with dreamy morning light.

Layout: The left panel is labeled “Before” at the top-left and shows the normal version; the right panel is labeled “After” at the top-right and shows the enhanced version with warmer indirect light, natural contact shadows, and soft glow wrapping around the subject. Add a large centered headline across the top reading プロンプト比較：光の回り込みGI. Add bottom-left Japanese label 通常生成 on the left panel and bottom-right Japanese label 光の回り込みGI on the right panel. All overlay text is bold white with a dark drop shadow for readability.

Subject details: Show the same androgynous anime boy in both panels, seated indoors in a cozy bedroom by a bright window. He has fluffy layered white-silver hair with lavender shadows, pale skin, and a slim elegant build. His face is intentionally covered by one large opaque pale mauve square censor block centered over the face in each panel; use exactly 2 censor blocks total, one per panel. His right hand rests near his cheek, partially visible beside the censor block. He wears a luxurious white robe or kimono-like top with navy-blue inner layers and wide sleeves, trimmed with metallic silver edges, decorated with star and crescent moon motifs. Include a crescent moon pendant necklace with a dangling blue gemstone.

Background details: The room contains exactly 1 large window visible behind the subject, soft curtains, a bed or cushioned seat, a small shelf or windowsill with perfume bottles and ornaments, and exactly 1 hanging crescent-moon decoration on each panel. The palette is lavender, white, pale blue, and warm sunlight.

Lighting comparison: Left “Before” panel should look flatter and cooler, with less bounce light and weaker shadows. Right “After” panel should visibly improve depth: add soft global illumination, warm sunlight wrapping around hair, face area, hands, robe folds, and shoulders; add subtle contact shadows where the hand touches the face area and where sleeves overlap; add bloom near the window and brighter rim light on the hair. Keep the character pose and composition identical between panels.

Constraints: Countable elements must remain exact: 2 comparison panels, 1 vertical divider, 4 text labels total, 2 face censor blocks, and 2 hanging crescent decorations. No watermark, no extra logos, no additional panels.\

She holds one lush bouquet of red, pink, and ivory roses with long burgundy ribbons. Her hair is extremely long, flowing, golden blonde, with soft curls and floral accessories. The face should be softly simplified or lightly obscured, keeping the focus on the dress design. Background: sunlit rose-covered archway, stone path, floating petals, dreamy bokeh.

Right-side layout: Include exactly 9 bordered reference panels arranged in a clean fashion-spec grid. Goal: Create a dramatic vertical Japanese light-novel/manga cover illustration for a fantasy romance series, with ornate icy magic, gothic academy atmosphere, and bold Japanese cover typography.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 cover, dense full-bleed composition, high-detail anime rendering, cold blue, violet, silver, white, and hot pink glow accents.

Layout: Two main characters dominate the foreground. The left character is a silver-haired noble girl shown from the waist up, angled slightly right, with very long flowing white-silver hair, a jeweled floral hair ornament, black gothic lace dress, corset details, ribbons, gems, and snowflake motifs. Her right hand reaches toward the viewer, casting a bright crystalline ice magic burst. The right character is a black-haired young nobleman behind her, slightly taller, angled left, wearing a dark ornate military-academy coat with silver embroidery and a loosened formal shirt. Both main faces are intentionally covered by flat semi-opaque gray square censor blocks: exactly 2 face-covering squares, one over each foreground character’s face.

Background: A moonlit gothic ice palace or academy castle with glowing windows fills the upper center, surrounded by snow, stars, frosty trees, and a wrought-iron gate on the left. Add exactly 1 distant silhouetted girl standing near the open gate, backlit and mysterious. The environment should feel like a frozen magical world at night.

Magic and objects: Surround the characters with numerous sharp translucent ice shards, snowflakes, sparkling frost particles, and blue-white crystal refractions. Include one large glowing snowflake magic sigil centered on the heroine’s outstretched hand. Keep the ice shards dynamic, radiating diagonally across the cover.

Text content: Add exactly 5 major visible text groups. 1) Top-left glowing pink-and-white question headline: 妹がいつもと違う？. 2) Top-right ornate black plaque with white border and Japanese episode label: 第1話. 3) Large central-to-lower main title, layered in blue, white, black, and hot pink glow: 転生したら、氷の義妹が俺だけ恋愛モードで最強だった件. 4) Lower-left vertical author/original-work announcement in bold white: 原作 崩壊、開始。. 5) Very bottom small decorative subtitle strip with ornaments: 〜超絶美人な義妹の溺愛が世界を壊す!?〜.

Visual style: Premium Japanese fantasy manga cover, highly polished digital painting, intricate linework, luminous bloom, dramatic rim lighting, icy particle effects, ornate typography integrated into the artwork, high contrast, romantic suspense mood.

Constraints: Preserve the vertical book-cover feel, keep exactly 2 foreground characters, exactly 1 distant silhouette, exactly 2 gray censor squares over the foreground faces, and exactly 5 major text groups. Do not add logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, panel borders, or extra characters.\

title: 超现实404文艺复兴拼贴

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a 3:2 horizontal surreal Renaissance-collage poster about a digital 404 void, combining antique manuscript design, classical sculpture, cybernetic ruin, and obsolete computer UI.

Canvas: Square-ish 3:2 editorial poster composition on aged beige parchment paper with stains, fibers, faint grid lines, registration marks, thin drafting guides, tiny technical annotations, and a torn-paper lower edge revealing a strip of dark glitchy code/static underneath.

Main subject: A colossal reclining Renaissance marble statue of a bearded male figure, like a fallen classical god or philosopher, filling the lower two-thirds of the image diagonally from bottom left to upper right. The stone body is cracked, eroded, and broken open in multiple places, exposing dense gold-and-black circuitry, server boards, mechanical ribs, and electronic components inside. Thick black and gray cables coil around and through the statue, wrapping the torso, shoulder, arm, and legs like vines. Add heavy industrial metal braces and rails strapped across the figure, with small triangular markings and embedded panels. The statue’s head is tilted back toward the upper right, eyes closed or lifeless, with a weathered curly beard and hair.

Background and symbols: Place one large muted burnt-orange red sun disk behind the statue’s head and upper torso, slightly right of center. Scatter exactly 44 small black hourglass icons across the upper half of the poster, varying size and opacity, with a few larger hourglass symbols near the top right and upper center. Behind the figure, include a distant broken stone wall or ruined fortress silhouette running horizontally.

Typography and left panel: On the upper left, set a large refined serif headline in tall condensed Renaissance editorial type: “SCROLLING INTO THE VOID”, stacked in four lines, with “VOID” in muted rusty red and the other words in dark charcoal. Add tiny technical labels around it such as “FIG. 7”, “MEMENTO MORI”, “SYSTEM FAILURE”, and faint Latin-like filler text. Below the headline, create a thin vertical index with exactly 3 numbered entries labeled 01, 02, and 03, each with tiny unreadable pseudo-academic notes. Add delicate compass, measurement, and chart lines in the left and center background.

Error UI detail: Near the lower right over the cables and statue, place one small retro Windows-style dialog box with a blue title bar reading “System Error”. The dialog message should say: “The universe has encountered a fatal error. Reality cannot continue.” Include exactly one centered gray button labeled “OK”.

Visual style: Hyper-detailed surreal collage, neo-Renaissance engraving meets cyberpunk archaeology, photorealistic textures mixed with vintage print design, muted sepia palette with charcoal black, stone gray, oxidized gold circuitry, and a single rusty red accent. Use dramatic but soft museum-like lighting, crisp detail, layered paper textures, and high-end editorial poster composition.

Constraints: Keep the composition spacious and horizontal with strong negative space in the upper left; no modern glossy sci-fi neon except subtle glitch colors at the torn bottom edge; no extra people; no watermark; preserve the exact main headline text SCROLLING INTO THE VOID, the red sun color muted burnt-orange red, the statue subject reclining bearded Renaissance marble god, the error message The universe has encountered a fatal error. Reality cannot continue., and the poster material aged beige parchment paper.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a wide desktop screenshot of a GitHub repository README preview in dark mode, showing a design example for an ancient Chinese social media feed UI.

Canvas: 1200×612 px horizontal screenshot, dark navy GitHub interface, cropped like a browser window with no visible browser address bar. The composition is mostly empty dark GitHub background, with the README content centered slightly left of middle.

GitHub page layout: At the very top, show the GitHub file breadcrumb and toolbar. Include exactly 3 breadcrumb/file items: a branch selector labeled “main”, the repository name “GPT-Image2-Skill”, and the file name “README.zh.md”. Below it, show exactly 3 tab buttons on the left: “Preview”, “Code”, and “Blame”, followed by small metadata text reading approximately “2865 lines (2093 loc) · 204 KB”. On the right side of the toolbar, include exactly 6 small GitHub action buttons/icons, including a “Raw” button. Keep the UI crisp, dark, and realistic.

README content: On the dark page, place a short bold white Chinese heading near the upper left of the content area: “宋代社交媒体动态”. Beneath and to the right of this heading, display a single vertical smartphone-style mockup image.

Phone mockup subject: The phone mockup is an ancient Song dynasty themed social media app screen titled 宋朝朋友圈. It has a warm sepia-black background, gold text, parchment textures, and a moody historical aesthetic. At the top of the phone screen show a status bar with exactly 4 visible status elements: carrier text “大宋移动 5G”, centered era text “元丰三年”, battery percentage “88%”, and a battery icon. Below that, show exactly 3 navigation/header elements: a back arrow on the left, the large title “宋朝朋友圈” in the center, and a camera icon on the right.

Social post details: Show exactly 1 post. The post has exactly 1 square avatar on the left, a Song dynasty portrait with the face softly blurred. To the right of the avatar, show the username line 苏东坡 SuShi_Official. Under it, include the post text in Chinese: “刚到黄州，虽被贬但心情尚可。今日亲手做了东坡肉，味道绝佳。食谱见下图。” Render the text as warm off-white/gold calligraphic UI text.

Post image: Under the text, show exactly 1 large image card styled like an antique Chinese painting on parchment. It depicts a pale celadon plate holding a glossy square block of Dongpo pork tied with a dark green strip, sitting in brown sauce. The image card also contains vertical Chinese calligraphy on the left, a small red seal, and a faint ink landscape or branch detail in the upper background. The food illustration should look painterly, like a museum manuscript mixed with realistic food rendering.

Engagement area: Beneath the food card, show exactly 1 like row with a small red circular emblem icon and Chinese names/text reading approximately “黄庭坚、秦观、佛印 等 126 人觉得赞”. Below that, begin exactly 1 visible comment row with a small avatar and the comment “王安石：呵呵”, partially cut off near the bottom edge of the phone screen.

Visual style: The overall screenshot should look like a real GitHub README preview containing a generated UI sample. Use dark GitHub colors, subtle separators, small white-gray interface text, and high contrast. The embedded phone mockup should be warm, cinematic, ancient Chinese, parchment-and-ink inspired, with soft vignetting and realistic shadows.

Constraints: Keep the final image as a screenshot of the GitHub page, not just the phone UI. Include only one embedded phone mockup, one social post, one avatar, one food image, one like row, and one visible comment row. Do not add extra panels, extra posts, watermarks, or explanatory captions beyond the specified GitHub and README text.\

The main image area is divided into 4 equal vertical scenic panels showing iconic destinations at golden hour with soft glowing skies and cinematic realism. Panel 2: Sweden, Stockholm, a waterfront old-town skyline with church spires and warm sunset light reflected in the water; include a small Swedish flag above the labels SWEDEN and STOCKHOLM. Panel 3: Finland, Helsinki, a small stone castle-like island fortress in blue water under a bright sky; include a small Finnish flag above the labels FINLAND and HELSINKI. Panel 4: Norway, dramatic fjords with steep jagged mountains, a waterfall, and a tiny red-roof coastal village at the water’s edge; include a small Norwegian flag above the labels NORWAY and FJORDS OF NORWAY. Beneath the 4 country panels, add a row of 4 gold line icons with captions, evenly spaced: mountain icon with ICONIC LANDSCAPES, Viking ship icon with RICH HERITAGE, moose icon with WILD NATURE, camera icon with UNFORGETTABLE JOURNEYS. Near the bottom center, place a gold divider and the title A TASTE OF THE NORTH. Under it, show exactly 5 food thumbnail panels in a horizontal strip, each on a plate or bowl with warm appetizing lighting and dark blue framing: 1) Smørrebrød — Denmark, open-faced sandwich topped with shrimp; 2) Köttbullar — Sweden, Swedish meatballs with cream sauce and lingonberries; 3) Gravad lax — Finland, sliced cured salmon in a bowl; 4) Fish soup — Norway, creamy fish soup with herbs and seafood; 5) Kanelbulle — Sweden, a glossy cinnamon bun on a plate. prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cute square Instagram carousel cover post for 育児垢ママへ, encouraging moms to prepare early for Father’s Day. Use a warm hand-drawn Canva-like style with Japanese lettering.

Canvas: Square 1:1 vertical social media post, cream/off-white paper background with a thin rounded pink border inset from the edges. Soft pastel palette: blush pink, warm brown, peach, cream, and light orange. Pencil-crayon texture, watercolor shading, rounded friendly shapes.

Layout: At the top center, place a pink ribbon banner with stitched details containing the text 「育児垢ママへ」 in dark brown handwritten Japanese. Beneath it, add the main headline in very large dark brown brush lettering across two lines: 「父の日、」 and 「まだ早いと思った？」. To the right of the headline, add a white cloud speech bubble outlined in pink with the text 「6月21日だよ」. Below the headline, place a wide rounded coral-pink pill-shaped callout bar with white handwritten text and small radiating accent marks: 「仕込むなら今がベスト」.

Main illustration: Bottom half shows a cheerful mother and two children rendered as adorable squirrel-like characters, centered and sitting together. Count exactly 3 characters: 1 mother in the middle with orange hair in a high bun, squirrel ears, pink cardigan, holding a pink smartphone with a small heart on the back; 1 small girl on the left with orange pigtails, a pink bow, pink top, smiling and leaning in; 1 small child on the right with squirrel ears, striped cream-and-yellow shirt, large fluffy orange squirrel tail behind them, smiling toward the phone. All have round faces, rosy cheeks, big glossy eyes, tiny noses, and happy open mouths.

Decorative elements: Add exactly 8 pink heart/sparkle decorations around the poster: 1 large heart near the top left, 2 sparkles near the top right, 1 heart on the left above the memo, 2 small hearts/sparkles around the left-middle area, 1 small heart to the right of the characters, and 1 sparkle on the far right. Keep them light and hand-drawn.

Bottom details: In the bottom-left corner, place a tilted white memo card taped with pink washi tape. It must include a small heart and the word “memo” in pink, plus Japanese text in dark brown: 「育児垢ママ向け」 on one line and 「投稿スケジュール」 on the next. Along the bottom center, add exactly 10 small carousel progress dots: the first dot filled coral pink, the remaining 9 outlined or pale. In the bottom-right corner, add a large coral-pink stitched circle badge containing the white number 1.

Text content to preserve exactly: 「育児垢ママへ」, 「父の日、まだ早いと思った？」, 「6月21日だよ」, 「仕込むなら今がベスト」, 「memo」, 「育児垢ママ向け」, 「投稿スケジュール」, and 1.

Constraints: Make the typography look hand-lettered, not like a standard font. Keep the design soft, cute, approachable, and readable on Instagram. Avoid photorealism, hard shadows, clutter, extra characters, extra carousel dots, watermarks, or logos.\

prompt_en: Please generate an emotional photography work titled 'My Childhood Self and My Current Self Looking at Each Other' based on the clear personal photo I uploaded. Do not turn me into someone else, do not Westernize, do not use influencer-style filters, do not over-beautify, and do not generate a fake AI face. The entire image must allow someone to see at a glance that the left and right sides are different life stages of the same person. Composition: Generate a 4:5 vertical, realistic photography-style portrait. There are two figures in the frame, sitting in the same simple studio space, looking at each other, forming a gentle emotional exchange. Left side: Childhood version of me. Right side: Current me (adult version, face must match my uploaded photo). Both adopt natural sitting positions; the image is simple, the composition is stable, and the focus is on the eye contact and emotional connection between the two people. Left character: Childhood version of me. Please reasonably generate a childhood version of me based on my current looks, aged approximately 7 years old. Retain identity features that correspond to the present to ensure it looks like 'me as a child,' including the continuation of facial contours, eye temperament, and face shape. Requirements: With an innocent, natural, and warm smile; head turned slightly to the right, looking at the adult version of me; wearing a light gray T-shirt and blue jeans; the year '1999' clearly written above the head. Right character: My current self. The right side is the current me, which must strictly reference the real appearance in my uploaded photo. Requirements: The adult image must be natural and realistic; sitting, body slightly facing left; hands naturally resting on the chin; with a calm, gentle, and restrained smile; eyes looking at the childhood self on the left, presenting a gentle gaze as if conversing with the past self; wearing a white T-shirt and blue jeans; the year '2026' clearly written above the head. Scene and Background: The scene is a pure, soft professional studio background. Suggested background colors: light gray, warm gray, beige gray, or cream gray. The background should be simple and clean, with no clutter, no furniture, and no complex decorations. Make the image look like a real studio photograph rather than a poster design. Lighting and Atmosphere: Use soft, warm, cinematic lighting; light is even and natural, with slight three-dimensionality and soft shadows on the face. The overall atmosphere is gentle, quiet, healing, and has a sense of time flowing. The emotional focus is the gentle eye contact between the childhood self and the current self. Style Requirements: Overall style: professional portrait photography, minimalist emotional photography, realistic, natural, restrained, high-quality realistic style, focusing on character emotions and the visual communication between the two versions. Important Restrictions: Do not change my core looks; do not make the childhood version a stranger; no cartoon style, no illustration style, no AI plastic skin; no exaggerated makeup, no excessive smoothing; no complex backgrounds, no extra people; no incorrect hands, no extra fingers; no garbled text; no other text except for the years '1999' and '2026' at the top. Final Output: Output a 4:5 vertical, highly realistic, warm, minimalist, cinematic photography piece. On the left is the childhood me, and on the right is the current me, both sitting and looking at each other, like a real photograph about time, growth, and self-reconciliation.\
